description: This file defines the NormalizeException class, a custom exception used within the OrangeHRM API Serializer component to handle specific serialization errors related to missing attributes or unsupported types.

classes.name: NormalizeException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's base Exception, providing specific static constructors for different error scenarios in the API serializer.

methods.name: notSetRequiredAttributes
methods.description: Returns an instance of NormalizeException indicating that required model attributes were not set.

methods.name: unsupportedType
methods.description: Returns an instance of NormalizeException indicating that an object is of an unsupported type, including expected and actual type info.
